subject: an owl made from folded blank pages
art_direction: 奶白猫头鹰由书页折成，深蓝翼片带少量无字星点压纹。
visible_description: 奶白猫头鹰由书页折成，深蓝翼片带少量无字星点压纹。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Fold an owl from blank cream book pages, giving it compact fan-shaped cheeks and closed navy paper wings. Emboss only a few tiny star-shaped dimples into the wings without printed symbols. Tilt the head with thoughtful amusement and keep the eyes small. Soft grazing light reveals page layers on a pale blue-gray field. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
